Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by surging Treasury yields and rapidly rising mortgage rates. This environment makes borrowing more expensive and future earnings less valuable, directly pressuring your concentrated tech/chip holdings.

Your holdings: SOXL (-34.89%) and SPAL (-34.29%) are both leveraged ETFs with "SELL" status and significant drawdowns. Given you're on margin, these amplified drops need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond market stability and any further rate hikes. Also, monitor the performance of your leveraged ETFs, especially SOXL and SPAL.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management and consider reducing exposure to your most volatile, underperforming leveraged positions.
plays: SPAL: Trim or exit immediately. Your current price (16.52) is below its default stop (21.38), indicating a breach.
SOXL: Review your stop. With a -34.89% loss and "SELL" status, consider tightening your stop from the default 200 or trimming exposure.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market signals caution, and no scanner setup has a compelling real-world catalyst.
